caption: The drawing depicts a decorative object resembling a sculpted fruit arrangement mounted on a pedestal. At the top, there is a prominent round reddish-brown fruit with a textured surface, positioned centrally. Below it are two yellow-brown fruits flanking a smaller, pale circular fruit with red marks or seeds exposed at its center. Arranged among and below the fruits are dark green pointed leaves that form a backdrop and support, extending outward. Further down, near the base, are two large, smooth gray or silver oval shapes, possibly representing additional fruits or seeds, oriented diagonally outward to each side. A single elongated green shape and a vertical red segment are present at the lower center. The entire arrangement sits atop a gray, faceted pedestal with a wide base and a narrow neck. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or detailing. The composition is symmetrical and vertically aligned.
title: Mantle Ornament
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
